_contract: NINE probes. Supersedes the six-probe v1 pricing, which the 3-arm supplement made obsolete. Every component is MEASURED; nothing is a carried-forward worst case.

setup._measured: C1 attempt 18 completed setup in 6 min at $0.11

gates._measured: attempt 18 ran 14 gates inside its setup window

parent_replay._measured: 21.5 / 21.8 / 21.9 min on three 2026-09-27 sessions; the frozen digest reproduced every time

armB_causal_b1_scorer._measured: 2720.6646 s, the packing-v2 fresh full B1

recovery_9_probes._measured: 61.8 min mean over attempt 18's six probes, same recipe

decide_bootstrap_closeout._measured: attempt 18 closed out inside its 561.57 min; three contrasts rather than one

_allowances._why: 5, 8.5 and 150+ min observed on the same image; 45 is a cold image, not the pathological case
_allowances._why_that: nine probes priced from a MEAN of six

_two_independent_shortfalls.1_project_cap: the HARD ceiling $22.1451 exceeds the $19.9693 project headroom by $2.1758. Raising the project cap to at least $372.1758 would close it; $375.00 would leave a margin.
_two_independent_shortfalls.2_per_session_ceiling: the EXPECTED cost $17.1072 exceeds the $15.1475 per-session hard ceiling by $1.9597, so the chain does not fit ONE session even if the project cap rose. The per-session ceiling would have to reach at least $22.1451 to hold the hard bound.
_two_independent_shortfalls._why_splitting_is_not_the_answer: the chain could in principle run across two sessions, but formal measurement may not be retried, resumed or pooled across sessions once it has begun, and this repository has no resume contract for a partially trained 9-probe matrix. Splitting would be inventing resume semantics mid-experiment.
_two_independent_shortfalls.3_not_c3_s_own_allowance: The FORMAL allowance has $22.8249 of $45.4425 left and already covers the $22.1451 hard ceiling with $0.6798 to spare. Both binding limits are outside this experiment's book -- the project cumulative cap and the per-session ceiling. Derived live by scripts/consolidate/derive_budget.py.

_what_was_NOT_done_to_make_it_fit: presenting the expected value as a hard bound
